headlines.text: It was 2022 when Sammy Guevara vs. Andrade El Idolo went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.99. It was the first title opportunity of Andrade El Idolo's career. It marked Sammy Guevara's 10th match with the title on the line. An ambush by the Andrade-Hardy Family Office, with Sting and Darby Allin racing out for the save ? setting up a bigger six-man showdown between the two factions at the following Revolution pay-per-view.

On a Wednesday in 2026, back when Young Bucks & Perry vs. The Demand vs. The Young Bucks vs. The Rascalz (Wentz & Xavier) vs. FTR vs. GOA vs. Jack Perry vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Dezmond Xavier vs. Zachary Wentz vs. Cash Wheeler vs. Dax Harwood vs. Bishop Kaun vs. Toa Liona vs. Ricochet settled things in a Mile High Madness match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 8.84 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. In a chaotic "Mile High Madness" Anything Goes brawl born out of FTR spiking the Young Bucks' kid brother with a piledriver, Jack Perry, the Bucks and the Rascalz got their revenge on FTR and The Demand in a wild ten-man war.
It was 2026 when it was the first-ever encounter between Jon Moxley and El Clon, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a match that delivered.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2026, it marked the first-ever meeting between Brody King and Mark Davis on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a well-worked match.
Looking back to 2022, when Orange Cassidy vs. Anthony Bowens met in a Qualifying Match, serving as the night's main event on Rampage, rated 6.27.
Looking back to 2026, when it was the first-ever encounter between Gabe Kidd and Orange Cassidy on Dynamite, rated 6.41.
